question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Desperate
solution: The correct answer is '**Content**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Desperate**' is '**Content**'. • **Desperate**: out of control and ready to do anything to change the situation you are in because it is so terrible. (अत्‍यधिक निराशा के कारण दुस्‍साहसी, निराशोन्‍मत) • *Example: She became **desperate** when her money ran out.* • **Content**: happy or satisfied with what you have or do. (संतुष्‍ट) • *Example: I don’t need a new car—I’m perfectly **content** with the one I’ve got.* **Correct Answer:__** *Content.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Determined**: having firmly decided to do something or to succeed, even if it is difficult. (कठिन होने के बावजूद किसी काम में सफलता प्राप्त करने का संकल्प, कृतसंकल्‍प, दृढ़निश्‍चयी) • **Frantic**: extremely worried or frightened. (अत्‍यधिक चिंतित या भयभीत) • **Daring**: involving or taking risks; brave. (साहसी; बहादुर, निर्भीक) 3a:T5b3, The erroneous part is** 'and to feel secured'.**
